problems.problem: The ops apply the correction exactly. All 3 texts match the correction's quoted text, only the evidence's last sentence was swapped, and no other row or field changed. Those three sites set only userData.nature. baseCol is set on a source material only at core:230 (the sea). toonify at :284 does not copy baseCol: it makes a new one from the toon material's own colour (m.color.clone()) before the nature gain is applied.
problems.evidence: `grep -n baseCol shamble-core.js shamble-game.js shamble-editor.js` finds it only at core:221 (read), :230 (sea sets it), :284 (toonify sets it) and :357 (read). `sed -n 1414p` shows `leaf.userData.nature=true;` and nothing else. `sed -n 1417p` shows `bankMat.userData.nature=true;` and nothing else. `sed -n 3070p shamble-game.js` shows `leaf.userData.nature=true; bark.userData.nature=true;`. `sed -n 284p` shows `if(std.userData&&std.userData.nature){ m.userData.nature=true; m.userData.baseCol=m.color.clone(); m.color.multiplyScalar(_natureGain); }`. Every other cited line was checked and holds: core 221, 242, 271, 276, 357-359, 364, 366, 384, 386, 392, 395, 401, 404, 405, 413, 415, 416, 482, 646, 686, 687, 689, 716, 753-755; game 245, 577, 583, 598, 1200, 2573, 2575, 3237; editor 814, 877, 882. The enclosing functions are right: applyVillain 268, makeAMKRifle 708, _gunParts 745, applyEnv 203, applyFaction 643, toonify 278, _matSig 356. editor-undo-ground.md lines 4 and 13-14 and three-teams report lines 88-91 match.
